rules.name: canonical labels
rules.requirement: lowercase human-readable labels; preserve official acronyms in aliases

rules.name: category vocabulary
rules.requirement: category must be a controlled snake_case value and remain stable across versions

rules.name: version history
rules.requirement: renames create a new alias or revision record; never silently repurpose an existing term id

rules.name: team terminology
rules.requirement: team aliases are scoped by team and require owner, reason, and lock status
